verdict.rationale: New Relic's APM agents cover the major languages. Its CLI records deployment markers, which gives a form of release tracking. Log management mentions visibility into errors and traces, and alerts can fire on abnormal behavior, which only loosely approximates regression detection. Missing for 10: any evidence of errors grouped into issues, stack-trace views for errors, regression detection tied to releases, and independent or hands-on corroboration of error-tracking workflows.
